title: SEO Audit
summary: Find what holds your website back in Google, including crawling, indexing, redirects and slow pages.
outcome: Technical SEO audit report with issues and prioritized fixes.

title: Keyword Research
summary: Find the searches customers use and review competing pages to spot useful missing topics, even before you have a website.
outcome: Keyword research spreadsheet grouped by topic; competitor findings when agreed.

title: On-Page SEO
summary: Review page titles, headings, content and internal links to find what needs improvement for visitors and search.
outcome: Prioritized recommendations for pages and content; website edits only when agreed.

title: Local SEO
summary: Check how customers can find your business in local Google searches and on Maps, where relevant.
outcome: Local search visibility review and recommendations.

title: International SEO
summary: Check whether people in each target country can find the right language version of your website.
outcome: Review of language pages and country-specific search issues.

title: SEO Consultation
summary: Discuss your business goals, ask SEO questions and decide which work is worth doing first.
outcome: Practical guidance; a written plan is quoted separately.

title: SEO Retainer
summary: Ongoing SEO management for your website: investigate issues, agree priorities, implement approved improvements and review performance.
outcome: Monthly work log, verified changes and a clear list of next priorities.
